stem.text:
The percent of people who click on a link\, in response to seeing an advertisement on YouTube\,

can be modeled by the formula:

$  R \(t \)= - \(0.8 \)^(0.2  t )+ 0.6   $

where $quad  R \(t \)$ is the percentage\, in decimal form\, of people who click on the link

$t $ is the time in days.

Determine\, algebraically\, the number of days it will take for $45  % $ of people who see the

advertisement to click on the link.

stem.text: Given $f \(x \)= 3 - 2  x $\, determine the equation of $f ^(- 1 )\(x \)$.

extensions.latexSource: Given \(f(x)=3-2 x\), determine the equation of \(f^{-1}(x)\).

solution.text:
Let $y = f \(x \)$

$  y = 3 - 2  x   $

To determine the inverse of $f \(x \)$\, switch $x $ and $y $.

$   x  & = 3 - 2  y  \  2  y  & = 3 - x  \  y  & = frac(3 - x ,2 ) \  f ^(- 1 )\(x \) & = frac(3 - x ,2 )   $

\[ \begin{aligned} x & =3-2 y \\ 2 y & =3-x \\ y & =\frac{3-x}{2} \\ f^{-1}(x) & =\frac{3-x}{2} \end{aligned} \]
